drills.name: Fat-Burning Sprint Intervals
drills.objective: Improve cardiovascular fitness and maximize calorie burn through high-intensity sprint intervals

steps.action: Dynamic warm-up — leg swings, high knees, butt kicks x 2 mins
Sprint intervals — 20m sprint x 10 reps, 30s walking rest between each
Shuttle runs — sprint 20m, touch cone, sprint back x 6 reps
Cool-down jog and stretch

key_coaching_points: Drive with arms — arms power your sprint, not just legs
Low body angle for first 5m — then rise into upright sprint
Focus on maximum effort each sprint — rest fully between reps
Track time for each rep to measure improvement
drills.target_metric: 20m sprint under 3.2 seconds; complete all 10 reps without reducing effort

drills.name: Agility Ladder Drill
drills.objective: Improve footwork speed, lateral movement, and coordination for overall fitness and fat-burning

steps.action: Single-step — both feet in each rung, quick steps, arms pumping x 3 passes
Lateral shuffle — sideways through ladder, two steps per rung x 3 passes
In-out drill — feet in, feet out each rung x 3 passes
Ickey shuffle pattern x 3 passes

key_coaching_points: Stay on balls of feet — do not flat-foot
Maintain a consistent rhythm before trying to increase speed
Keep head up — do not look at the ladder
Arms should mirror foot speed — fast feet = fast arms
drills.target_metric: Complete 6m single-step ladder under 4 seconds after 4 weeks of training

drills.name: Aerobic Endurance Run
drills.objective: Build the aerobic base needed to sustain fat-burning and improve cardiovascular health

steps.action: Warm-up jog — 5 mins at easy conversational pace
Shuttle run — 20m shuttle to audio cue; start at Level 5, build to Level 10 over the session
Cool-down walk and calf + quad stretch

key_coaching_points: Pace yourself — do not sprint early levels, save energy
Touch the line fully before turning
Breathe in through nose, out through mouth for efficiency
Record the level reached each session to track progress
drills.target_metric: Complete 20-minute run without stopping; build to 30 minutes over 4 weeks

drills.name: Core Strength Circuit
drills.objective: Build the rotational core strength needed to support fat-loss workouts and prevent lower-back injury

steps.action: Plank hold — 3 sets x 45 seconds, 20s rest between sets
Russian twists — 3 sets x 20 reps (with or without medicine ball)
Dead bug — 3 sets x 10 reps per side (opposite arm/leg extension)
Hollow body hold — 3 sets x 30 seconds

key_coaching_points: Lower back must remain flat throughout — no arch
Breathe continuously — do not hold breath during holds
Slow and controlled > fast and sloppy
Engage glutes during plank — prevents hip sagging
drills.target_metric: Plank hold > 60 seconds; 20 Russian twist reps without losing form

drills.name: Flexibility and Mobility Routine
drills.objective: Maintain joint mobility and muscle length to prevent injuries and support full range of motion

steps.action: Hip flexor stretch — lunge position, 45 seconds per side x 2
Thoracic spine rotation — seated twist, 10 reps per side x 2 sets
Hamstring stretch — seated forward fold, 45 seconds x 2
Shoulder cross-body stretch — 30 seconds per arm x 2 sets
Child's pose and cat-cow — 10 reps slow breathing

key_coaching_points: Never stretch a cold muscle — always after warm-up or training
Hold stretches for minimum 30 seconds for lasting benefit
Do not bounce in a stretch — static holds only
Note any tight areas and report to coach for targeted work
drills.target_metric: Touch toes from standing (hamstring mobility); 90° torso rotation both sides (spine mobility)
